[size=4]Usage
[/size]
[list]
[*]StashToChests
[/list][list=1]

[/list][list]
[*]LockItems
[/list][list=1]
[*]Press the button (default LeftAlt) to lock the item at your backpack (inventory page). Let locked items do not be stash.
[*]Press the  button (default RightAlt) to clear the lockeditemslist.
[/list][list]
[*]CraftFromChests
[/list][list=1]
[*]Press the button (default K) to open the crafting page.
[/list][list]
[*]MoveChests
[/list][list=1]
[*]Pressed the button (default LeftShift) and left click the chest near player to pickup the chest and move it.
[/list]
